test_title: PYST 40: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: In how many years will ₹4,000 invested at the rate of 18% per annum simple interest amounts to ₹5,800?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4000

Rate of Interest (R) = 18% per annum

Amount (A) = ₹5800

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = A - P

Time (T) = SI / (P × R / 100)

**Calculation:**

SI = A - P

⇒ SI = 5800 - 4000

⇒ SI = ₹1800

T = SI / (P × R / 100)

⇒ T = (1800 × 100) / (4000 × 18 )

⇒ T = 1800 / (720)

⇒ T = 2.5 years

**The time required is 2.5 years.**
